Draw a heat_map object

Source: R/heat_map-internals.R
heat_map-methods.Rd

plot() redraws a heatmap on the current graphics device using the arguments originally supplied to heat_map. Any arguments supplied through ... override the original arguments, for example plot(hm, title = "New title"). Use data to redraw the heatmap with new data, as x refers to the heat_map object itself.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'heat_map'
plot(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'heat_map'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

object of class heat_map.

...

additional arguments passed to heat_map.

Value

x, invisibly.

Details

print() also redraws the heatmap, unless it was drawn within a custom layout (see heat_map_custom), in which case the recorded page is replayed as is.

Examples

hm <- heat_map(mtcars, scale = "column", popup = FALSE)
#> Applying range scaling to each column...

plot(hm, title = "mtcars")

plot(hm, data = mtcars[1:10, ])
